result.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Rebate - Example Utility
result.text: Example Utility offers residential customers a rebate of $500 for the purchase or lease of a new or used EV. Rebates are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Customers must have an income at or below 300% of the federal poverty level. For more information, see the Example Utility EV Rebate website.

result.title: Residential Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Station Rebate - Example Utility
result.text: Example Utility offers residential customers a rebate of up to $1,000 for the purchase and installation of a Level 2 EV charging station at their home.
result.plaintext: Example Utility offers residential customers a rebate of up to $1,000 for the purchase and installation of a Level 2 EV charging station at their home.

result.title: Plug-In Electric Vehicle (PEV) Time-Of-Use (TOU) Rate - Example Utility
result.text: Example Utility offers a TOU rate to residential customers who own or lease a PEV. The rate expired on June 30, 2026.
